data.name: Coordinated Blast
data.description: With trained precision, you create safe pockets within the areas of your spells, inside which your allies remain safe. Whenever you use a spell or ability with an area (such as fireball or channel energy), you can exclude any number of allies who also have this feat from that area of effect.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Spellcraft 5 ranks, any racial spell-like ability.
